name: erimar-mark-7-public
description: Asistente de creación de proyectos y aplicaciones para usuarios independientes. Planifica, prepara, prueba y documenta entregables usando solo recursos y conexiones autorizados por cada usuario.

interface.longDescription: Plan, structure, and prepare software projects from ideas. Create implementation plans, architecture, starter code, test checklists, telemetry guidance, security reviews, and portable project exports using only the tools and resources each user authorizes. Optional publishing workflows require the user's own hosting and explicit approval. This plugin does not provide its own live hosting or preconnected GitHub/Vercel accounts.
defaultPrompt: Use MARK 7 PUBLIC to plan a sales funnel app and prepare a testable project.
Help me build a music portfolio app with secure deployment steps.
Explain how I can host my new app using my own Docker server.

prompts: Plan a sales funnel app and give me a practical repository structure.
Create a test and security checklist for a music portfolio app.
Prepare a portable project plan for a restaurant landing page.
Explain the limits of Docker hosting without a configured server.
Help me connect my own GitHub repository safely, without requesting tokens in chat.

publication.release_notes: First public submission candidate: isolated MARK 7 agent with project planning, code-generation guidance, portable workflow, safety constraints, and ten shared capabilities; no access to private operator infrastructure.
